vc_checking.summary: All 29 cleaned manual obligations are semantically proofable under the unified one-byte Read relation. The three Read entailments unfold CircularAreaReadOneResult: the initial empty-state obligation eliminates the impossible live branch, while the two singleton-state obligations eliminate the impossible empty branch and recover the exact byte, empty successor state, and [Some byte] output. Return witnesses select a resource-compatible result branch and frame unchanged resources. Pure witnesses reduce InitState and record projections, with the repeated-write capacity bound following from 4 <= requested_pre. The force/full entailment is exactly discharged by the annotation-approved seed bridge. No annotation repair or new helper is required.
